4.12.6.s: arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam | trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartād avapado yajatrāḥ || pra vā eko mimaya bhūry āgo yan mā piteva kitavaṃ śaśāsa | āre pāśā āre aghāni devā mā mādhi putre vim iva grabhīṣṭa || ā ghā ye agnim indhate stṛṇanti barhir ānuṣak | yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā || yābhyāṃ svar ajanann agra eva yā ātasthatur bhuvanāni viśvā | pra carṣaṇī vṛṣaṇā vajrabāhum agnim indraṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ huvema || agnā indraś ca dāśuṣo duroṇe sutāvato yajñam ihopayātam | amardhantā somapeyāya devā || anv adya no anumatir anv id anumate tvam || rākām ahaṃ suhavāṃ suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā | sīvyatv apaḥ sūcyāchidyamānayā dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyam ukthyam || yās te rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhir dadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni | tābhir no adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrapoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā || sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānām asi svasā | juṣasva havyam āhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ || yā supāṇiḥ svaṅguriḥ suṣūmā bahusūvarī | tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana || kuhūm ahaṃ sukṛtaṃ vidmanāpasam asmin yajñe suhavāṃ johavīmi | sā no dadātu śravaṇaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tasyai te devi haviṣā vidhema || kuhūr devānām amṛtasya patnī havyā no asya haviṣaḥ śṛṇotu | sa dāśuṣe kiratu bhūri vāmaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ cikituṣe dadhātu || dhātā dadhātu no rayiṃ prācīṃ jīvātum akṣitām | vayaṃ devasya dhīmahi sumatiṃ satyadharmaṇaḥ || dhātā dadātu dāśuṣe vasūni prajākāmāya mīḍhuṣe duroṇe | tasmai devā amṛtāḥ saṃvyayantāṃ viśve devāso aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ || prātar yajadhvam aśvinā hinota na sāyam asti devayā ajuṣṭam | utānyo asmad yajate vi cāvaḥ pūrvaḥpūrvo yajamāno vanīyān || prātaryāvāṇā prathamā yajadhvaṃ purā gṛdhrād araruṣaḥ pibātaḥ | prātar hi yajñam aśvinā dadhāte praśaṃsanti kavayaḥ pūrvabhājaḥ || indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayaṃ sakhyāya svastaye | huvema vājasātaye || yan nirṇijā || tvam agne bṛhad vayo dadhāsi deva dāśuṣe | kavir gṛhapatir yuvā || havyavāḍ agnir ajaraḥ pitā no vibhur vibhāvā sudṛśīko asme | sugārhapatyāḥ sam iṣo didīhy asmadryak saṃmimīhi śravāṃsi || tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo jīvātuṃ na marāmahe | priyastotro vanaspatiḥ || brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnāṃ kavir viprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām | śyeno gṛdhrāṇāṃ svadhitir vanānāṃ somaḥ pavitram atyeti rebhan || ā viśvadevaṃ satpatiṃ sūktair adyā vṛṇīmahe | satyasavaṃ savitāram || ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayann amṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca | hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanā vipaśyan || udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇā vāvadato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ | giribhrajo normayo madanto bṛhaspatim abhy arkā anāvan || haṃsair iva sakhibhir vāvadadbhir aśmanmayāni nahanā vyasyan | bṛhaspatir abhikanikradad gā uta prāstaud uc ca vidvaṃ agāyat || tvaṃ sutasya pītaye sadyo vṛddho ajāyathāḥ | indra jyaiṣṭhyāya sukrato || bhuvas tvam indra brahmaṇo mahān bhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣu yajñiyaḥ | bhuvo nṝṃś cyautno viśvasmin bhare jyeṣṭhaś ca mantro viśvacarṣaṇe || pra sa mitrānamīvāsaḥ || yac cid dhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam | minīmasi dyavidyavi || yat kiṃcedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane 'bhidrohaṃ manuṣyāś carāmasi | acittī yat tava dharmā yuyopima mā nas tasmād enaso deva rīriṣaḥ || yathā no aditiḥ karat paśve nṛbhyo yathā gave | yathā tokāya rudriyam || mā nas toke tanaye mā nā āyuṣi mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ | vīrān mā no rudra bhāmito vadhīr haviṣmanto namasā vidhema te || ya imā viśvā jātāny āśrāvayati ślokena | pra ca suvāti savitā || viśvā rūpāṇi || aśvinā yajñam āgataṃ dāśuṣaḥ purudaṃsasā | pūṣā rakṣatu no rayim || imaṃ yajñam aśvinā vardhayantemau vīryaṃ yajamānāya dhattām | imau paśūn rakṣatāṃ viśvato naḥ pūṣā naḥ pātu sadam aprayuchan || pra te mahe sarasvati subhage vājinīvati | satyavāce bhare matim || idaṃ te havyaṃ ghṛtavat sarasvati satyavāce prayatemā havīṃṣi | imāni ta uditā śaṃtamāni tebhir vayaṃ subhagāsaḥ syāma ||
4.12.6.d: अर्वाञ्चो अद्या भवता यजत्रा आ वो हार्दि भयमानो व्ययेयम् । त्राध्वं नो देवा निजुरो वृकस्य त्राध्वं कर्ताद् अवपदो यजत्राः ॥ प्र वा एको मिमय भूर्य् आगो यन् मा पितेव कितवं शशास । आरे पाशा आरे अघानि देवा मा माधि पुत्रे विम् इव ग्रभीष्ट ॥ आ घा ये अग्निम् इन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिर् आनुषक् । येषाम् इन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥ याभ्यां स्वर् अजनन्न् अग्र एव या आतस्थतुर् भुवनानि विश्वा । प्र चर्षणी वृषणा वज्रबाहुम् अग्निम् इन्द्रं वृत्रहणं हुवेम ॥ अग्ना इन्द्रश् च दाशुषो दुरोणे सुतावतो यज्ञम् इहोपयातम् । अमर्धन्ता सोमपेयाय देवा ॥ अन्व् अद्य नो अनुमतिर् अन्व् इद् अनुमते त्वम् ॥ राकाम् अहं सुहवां सुष्टुती हुवे शृणोतु नः सुभगा बोधतु त्मना । सीव्यत्व् अपः सूच्याछिद्यमानया ददातु वीरं शतदायम् उक्थ्यम् ॥ यास् ते राके सुमतयः सुपेशसो याभिर् ददासि दाशुषे वसूनि । ताभिर् नो अद्य सुमना उपागहि सहस्रपोषं सुभगे रराणा ॥ सिनीवालि पृथुष्टुके या देवानाम् असि स्वसा । जुषस्व हव्यम् आहुतं प्रजां देवि दिदिड्ढि नः ॥ या सुपाणिः स्वङ्गुरिः सुषूमा बहुसूवरी । तस्यै विश्पत्न्यै हविः सिनीवाल्यै जुहोतन ॥ कुहूम् अहं सुकृतं विद्मनापसम् अस्मिन् यज्ञे सुहवां जोहवीमि । सा नो ददातु श्रवणं पितॄणां तस्यै ते देवि हविषा विधेम ॥ कुहूर् देवानाम् अमृतस्य पत्नी हव्या नो अस्य हविषः शृणोतु । स दाशुषे किरतु भूरि वामं रायस्पोषं चिकितुषे दधातु ॥ धाता दधातु नो रयिं प्राचीं जीवातुम् अक्षिताम् । वयं देवस्य धीमहि सुमतिं सत्यधर्मणः ॥ धाता ददातु दाशुषे वसूनि प्रजाकामाय मीढुषे दुरोणे । तस्मै देवा अमृताः संव्ययन्तां विश्वे देवासो अदितिः सजोषाः ॥ प्रातर् यजध्वम् अश्विना हिनोत न सायम् अस्ति देवया अजुष्टम् । उतान्यो अस्मद् यजते वि चावः पूर्वःपूर्वो यजमानो वनीयान् ॥ प्रातर्यावाणा प्रथमा यजध्वं पुरा गृध्राद् अररुषः पिबातः । प्रातर् हि यज्ञम् अश्विना दधाते प्रशंसन्ति कवयः पूर्वभाजः ॥ इन्द्रा नु पूषणा वयं सख्याय स्वस्तये । हुवेम वाजसातये ॥ यन् निर्णिजा ॥ त्वम् अग्ने बृहद् वयो दधासि देव दाशुषे । कविर् गृहपतिर् युवा ॥ हव्यवाड् अग्निर् अजरः पिता नो विभुर् विभावा सुदृशीको अस्मे । सुगार्हपत्याः सम् इषो दिदीह्य् अस्मद्र्यक् संमिमीहि श्रवांसि ॥ त्वं च सोम नो वशो जीवातुं न मरामहे । प्रियस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिः ॥ ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनां कविर् विप्राणां महिषो मृगाणाम् । श्येनो गृध्राणां स्वधितिर् वनानां सोमः पवित्रम् अत्येति रेभन् ॥ आ विश्वदेवं सत्पतिं सूक्तैर् अद्या वृणीमहे । सत्यसवं सवितारम् ॥ आ कृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्न् अमृतं मर्त्यं च । हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेना देवो याति भुवना विपश्यन् ॥ उदप्रुतो न वयो रक्षमाणा वावदतो अभ्रियस्येव घोषाः । गिरिभ्रजो नोर्मयो मदन्तो बृहस्पतिम् अभ्य् अर्का अनावन् ॥ हंसैर् इव सखिभिर् वावदद्भिर् अश्मन्मयानि नहना व्यस्यन् । बृहस्पतिर् अभिकनिक्रदद् गा उत प्रास्तौद् उच् च विद्वं अगायत् ॥ त्वं सुतस्य पीतये सद्यो वृद्धो अजायथाः । इन्द्र ज्यैष्ठ्याय सुक्रतो ॥ भुवस् त्वम् इन्द्र ब्रह्मणो महान् भुवो विश्वेषु सवनेषु यज्ञियः । भुवो नॄंश् च्यौत्नो विश्वस्मिन् भरे ज्येष्ठश् च मन्त्रो विश्वचर्षणे ॥ प्र स मित्रानमीवासः ॥ यच् चिद् धि ते विशो यथा प्र देव वरुण व्रतम् । मिनीमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥ यत् किंचेदं वरुण दैव्ये जने ऽभिद्रोहं मनुष्याश् चरामसि । अचित्ती यत् तव धर्मा युयोपिम मा नस् तस्माद् एनसो देव रीरिषः ॥ यथा नो अदितिः करत् पश्वे नृभ्यो यथा गवे । यथा तोकाय रुद्रियम् ॥ मा नस् तोके तनये मा ना आयुषि मा नो गोषु मा नो अश्वेषु रीरिषः । वीरान् मा नो रुद्र भामितो वधीर् हविष्मन्तो नमसा विधेम ते ॥ य इमा विश्वा जातान्य् आश्रावयति श्लोकेन । प्र च सुवाति सविता ॥ विश्वा रूपाणि ॥ अश्विना यज्ञम् आगतं दाशुषः पुरुदंससा । पूषा रक्षतु नो रयिम् ॥ इमं यज्ञम् अश्विना वर्धयन्तेमौ वीर्यं यजमानाय धत्ताम् । इमौ पशून् रक्षतां विश्वतो नः पूषा नः पातु सदम् अप्रयुछन् ॥ प्र ते महे सरस्वति सुभगे वाजिनीवति । सत्यवाचे भरे मतिम् ॥ इदं ते हव्यं घृतवत् सरस्वति सत्यवाचे प्रयतेमा हवींषि । इमानि त उदिता शंतमानि तेभिर् वयं सुभगासः स्याम ॥
4.12.6.m:
Turn toward us today, ye worthy of worship! Fearing, let me enter into your heart. / Protect us, O gods, from the weariness of the wolf; protect us, O holy ones, from falling into the pit!
One of you has made many a transgression disappear, as a father corrects a gambler. / Far away be the fetters, far away the evils, O gods! Do not seize me as a bird upon its child!
Indeed, they who kindle the fire, who spread the sacrificial grass continuously, / they have Indra as a youthful friend.
By whom they brought forth the light in the beginning, who have mounted upon all beings, / we would invoke both the vanquishers of peoples, the bulls, Agni and Indra whose arm wields the vajra, the slayer of Vṛtra.
O Agni and Indra, come here to the sacrifice in the home of the worshipful one who has pressed [Soma], / unwearying gods, for the drinking of Soma!
May Anumati today... / Indeed, O Anumati, do thou...
I invoke Rākā, easily invoked, with fine praise; may she hear us, the fortunate one, and notice by herself! / May she sew the work with a needle that does not break; may she grant a hero with a hundred gifts, worthy of song.
O Rākā, those good thoughts of thine that are richly adorned, by which thou givest wealth to the worshiper, / with these come to us today, being well-minded, bestowing a thousandfold nourishment, O fortunate one.
O Sinīvālī of broad tufts, who art the sister of the gods, / enjoy the offering poured out; O goddess, grant us offspring!
She who has fine hands, fine fingers, who brings forth well, bearing many [children], / to her, the mistress of the settlement, Sinīvālī, pour the oblation!
Kuhū, who acts well, skillful in deed, easily invoked, do I summon repeatedly at this sacrifice; / may she grant us the renown of the fathers; to thee, O goddess, let us do honor with an oblation!
May Kuhū, wife of the immortal gods, hear the offerings of this our oblation; / let her scatter much bounty for the worshiper; let her grant increase of wealth to the mindful one.
May the Creator establish for us wealth, life forward that does not waste away; / may we take to heart the goodwill of the god whose law is true.
May the Creator give wealth to the worshipful one desiring offspring, to the generous one in his dwelling; / may the immortal gods wrap him round, all the gods and Aditi in unison.
Sacrifice in the morning, impel the Aśvins; there is no unloved wayfarer of the gods at evening. / And another sacrifices besides us, and [the dawn] has shone forth; earlier and earlier the sacrificer is more winning.
Sacrifice first to those who travel in the morning, before the greedy, ungiving [foe] drinks. / For the Aśvins establish the sacrifice in the morning; the sages who receive the first share praise them.
Indra now and Pūṣan would we invoke / for friendship, for well-being, for the winning of booty.
When with a mantle...
Thou, O Agni, dost establish great vigor for the worshipful one, O god, / a youthful householder, a poet.
Agni who bears the oblation, unaging, our father, pervasive, radiant, fair to behold for us; / shine forth food with good masters of the house; measure out renown toward us!
And thou, O Soma, dost control our life so that we shall not die, / a plant beloved of praises.
The Hotṛ of the gods, the leader of the poets, the sage among the inspired, the buffalo among wild beasts, / the falcon of vultures, the axe of forests, Soma crosses the sieve roaring.
Today we choose with good hymns the all-godly lord of truth, / Savitṛ of true impulse.
Coming through the dark realm of air, putting to rest both the immortal and the mortal, / god Savitṛ comes in his golden chariot, surveying all beings.
Like birds swimming in water, watching, shouting like the noises of a rain-cloud, / rejoicing like mountain-rushing waves, the songs have roared toward Bṛhaspati.
Casting off the stone-made bonds with shouting companions as with geese, / Bṛhaspati, bellowing over the cows, praised aloud and, knowing, sang.
Thou wast born, grown instantly, to drink the pressed [Soma], / O Indra, for supremacy, O thou of good insight!
Indra, mayst thou be great through sacred speech; mayst thou be worthy of sacrifice at all pressings; / mayst thou be a shaker of men in every battle, and the highest incantation, O thou who belongest to all peoples!
Forward he, O Mitra... / free from disease...
Whatever ordinance of thine, O god Varuṇa, we violate, / day by day as the folks [are wont to do],
Whatever offense we mortals commit here against the divine people, O Varuṇa, / if through lack of thought we have disrupted thy laws, do not harm us for that sin, O god!
As Aditi shall make for our beast, as for our men, as for our cow, / as Rudra's [favor] for our offspring,
Do not harm us in our offspring, in our progeny, nor in our life, nor in our cows, nor in our horses; / do not slay our heroes in thy anger, O Rudra; bearing oblations, let us honor thee with homage!
He who causes all these creatures to hear with his song, / Savitṛ impels [them] forth.
All forms...
O Aśvins, wondrous in deeds, come to the sacrifice of the worshiper; / may Pūṣan protect our wealth.
May the two Aśvins make this sacrifice grow; let the two bestow vigor upon the sacrificer; / let the two protect our cattle on all sides; may Pūṣan protect us, ever unneglectful.
To thee, the great, the fortunate, rich in prizes, / of true speech, O Sarasvatī, I bring forward a thought.
This oblation for thee is rich in ghee, O Sarasvatī; these offerings are presented to the one of true speech; / these [songs] spoken for thee are most comforting; with them may we be fortunate!

4.13.1.s: pra devaṃ devyā dhiyety aṣṭau || añjanti tvām adhvare devayanto vanaspate madhunā daivyena | yad ūrdhvas tiṣṭhā draviṇeha dhattād yad vā kṣayo mātur asyā upasthe || uñśrayasva vanaspate varṣman pṛthivyā adhi | sumitī mīyamāno varco dhā yajñavāhase || samiddhasya śrayamāṇaḥ purastād brahma vanvāno ajaraṃ suvīram | āre asmad amatiṃ bādhamānā uñśrayasva mahate saubhagāya || ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye || ūrdhvo naḥ pāhy aṃhaso ni ketunā viśvaṃ sam atriṇaṃ daha | kṛdhī na ūrdhvāñ carathāya jīvase vidā deveṣu no duvaḥ || jāto jāyate sudinatve ahnāṃ samarya ā vidathe vardhamānaḥ | punanti dhīrā apaso manīṣā devayā viprā udiyarti vācam || yuvā suvāsāḥ parivītā āgāt sa u śreyān bhavati jāyamānaḥ | taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavayā unnayanti svādhyo manasā devayantaḥ ||
4.13.1.d: प्र देवं देव्या धियेत्य् अष्टौ ॥ अञ्जन्ति त्वाम् अध्वरे देवयन्तो वनस्पते मधुना दैव्येन । यद् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठा द्रविणेह धत्ताद् यद् वा क्षयो मातुर् अस्या उपस्थे ॥ उञ्श्रयस्व वनस्पते वर्ष्मन् पृथिव्या अधि । सुमिती मीयमानो वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसे ॥ समिद्धस्य श्रयमाणः पुरस्ताद् ब्रह्म वन्वानो अजरं सुवीरम् । आरे अस्मद् अमतिं बाधमाना उञ्श्रयस्व महते सौभगाय ॥ ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये ॥ ऊर्ध्वो नः पाह्य् अंहसो नि केतुना विश्वं सम् अत्रिणं दह । कृधी न ऊर्ध्वाञ् चरथाय जीवसे विदा देवेषु नो दुवः ॥ जातो जायते सुदिनत्वे अह्नां समर्य आ विदथे वर्धमानः । पुनन्ति धीरा अपसो मनीषा देवया विप्रा उदियर्ति वाचम् ॥ युवा सुवासाः परिवीता आगात् स उ श्रेयान् भवति जायमानः । तं धीरासः कवया उन्नयन्ति स्वाध्यो मनसा देवयन्तः ॥
4.13.1.m:
"Forward to the god with divine prayer" — eight [verses].
Devoted to the gods, they anoint you at the rite, O tree, with divine honey.
Whether you stand upright, bestow wealth here, or whether your resting place is in the lap of this mother.
Raise yourself up, O tree, on the summit of the earth!
Being measured with good measure, bestow splendor upon him who bears the sacrifice!
Resting in front of the kindled [fire], winning prayer, ageless, with good heroes,
warding far away lack of thought from us, raise yourself up for great good fortune!
Upright for our aid!
Upright, protect us from distress; with your banner burn down every devourer!
Make us upright to walk, to live! Find favor for us among the gods!
Born, he is born in the auspiciousness of days, growing in the assembly, at the distribution [of gifts].
The wise, active ones purify him with insight; the inspired god-seeker raises his voice.
A youth, well robed, encircled, he has come; he becomes yet better when being born.
Him the wise poets raise up, devout, devoted to the gods in mind.
"Unto you, O divine Savitṛ" — thirteen [verses].

4.13.2.s: abhi tvā deva savitar iti trayodaśa hotā yakṣad agniṃ samidhā suṣamidhā samiddhaṃ nābhā pṛthivyāḥ saṃgathe vāmasya varṣman diva iḍas pade vetv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣat tanūnapātam aditer garbhaṃ bhuvanasya gopāṃ madhvādya devo devebhyo devayānān patho anaktu vetv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣan narāśaṃsaṃ nṛśastaṃ nṝṃṣpraṇetraṃ gobhir vapāvānt syād vīraiḥ śaktīvān rathaiḥ prathamayāvā hiraṇyaiś candrī vetv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣad agnim iḍa īḍito devo devaṃ ā ca vakṣad dūto havyavāḍ amūrā upemaṃ yajñam upemāṃ devo devahūtim avatu vetv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣad barhiḥ suṣṭarīmorṇamradā asmin yajñe vi ca pra ca prathatāṃ svāsasthaṃ devebhya em enad adya vasavo rudrā ādityāḥ svadantu priyam indrasyāstu vetv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣad dura ṛṣvāḥ kavaṣyo kośadhāvanīr ud ātābhir jihatāṃ vi pakṣobhiḥ śrayantāṃ suprāyaṇā asmin yajñe viśrayantām ṛtāvṛdho vyantv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣad uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī supeśasā nṝṃṣ patibhyo yoniṃ kṛṇvāne saṃsmayamāne indreṇa devair edaṃ barhiḥ sīdatāṃ vītām ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣad daivyā hotārā mandrā potārā kavī pracetasā sviṣṭam adyānyaḥ karad iṣā svabhigūrtam anya ūrjā satavasemaṃ yajñaṃ divi deveṣu dhattāṃ vītām ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣat tisro devīr apasām apastamo 'chidram adyedam apas tanvatāṃ devebhyo devīr devam apo vyantv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣat tvaṣṭāram aciṣṭum apākaṃ retodhāṃ viśravasaṃ yaśodhāṃ pururūpam akāmakarśanaṃ supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ syāt suvīro vīrair vetv ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣad vanaspatim upāvasrakṣad dhiyo joṣṭāraṃ śaśaman naraḥ svadāt svadhitir ṛtuthādya devo devebhyo havyāvāḍ vetv ājyasya hotar yaja ||
4.13.2.d: अभि त्वा देव सवितर् इति त्रयोदश होता यक्षद् अग्निं समिधा सुषमिधा समिद्धं नाभा पृथिव्याः संगथे वामस्य वर्ष्मन् दिव इडस् पदे वेत्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षत् तनूनपातम् अदितेर् गर्भं भुवनस्य गोपां मध्वाद्य देवो देवेभ्यो देवयानान् पथो अनक्तु वेत्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षन् नराशंसं नृशस्तं नॄंष्प्रणेत्रं गोभिर् वपावान्त् स्याद् वीरैः शक्तीवान् रथैः प्रथमयावा हिरण्यैश् चन्द्री वेत्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षद् अग्निम् इड ईडितो देवो देवं आ च वक्षद् दूतो हव्यवाड् अमूरा उपेमं यज्ञम् उपेमां देवो देवहूतिम् अवतु वेत्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षद् बर्हिः सुष्टरीमोर्णम्रदा अस्मिन् यज्ञे वि च प्र च प्रथतां स्वासस्थं देवेभ्य एम् एनद् अद्य वसवो रुद्रा आदित्याः स्वदन्तु प्रियम् इन्द्रस्यास्तु वेत्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षद् दुर ऋष्वाः कवष्यो कोशधावनीर् उद् आताभिर् जिहतां वि पक्षोभिः श्रयन्तां सुप्रायणा अस्मिन् यज्ञे विश्रयन्ताम् ऋतावृधो व्यन्त्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षद् उषासानक्ता बृहती सुपेशसा नॄंष् पतिभ्यो योनिं कृण्वाने संस्मयमाने इन्द्रेण देवैर् एदं बर्हिः सीदतां वीताम् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षद् दैव्या होतारा मन्द्रा पोतारा कवी प्रचेतसा स्विष्टम् अद्यान्यः करद् इषा स्वभिगूर्तम् अन्य ऊर्जा सतवसेमं यज्ञं दिवि देवेषु धत्तां वीताम् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षत् तिस्रो देवीर् अपसाम् अपस्तमो ऽछिद्रम् अद्येदम् अपस् तन्वतां देवेभ्यो देवीर् देवम् अपो व्यन्त्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षत् त्वष्टारम् अचिष्टुम् अपाकं रेतोधां विश्रवसं यशोधां पुरुरूपम् अकामकर्शनं सुपोषः पोषैः स्यात् सुवीरो वीरैर् वेत्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज होता यक्षद् वनस्पतिम् उपावस्रक्षद् धियो जोष्टारं शशमन् नरः स्वदात् स्वधितिर् ऋतुथाद्य देवो देवेभ्यो हव्यावाड् वेत्व् आज्यस्य होतर् यज ॥
4.13.2.m:
May the Hotṛ worship Agni kindled with good kindling-wood on the navel of the earth, at the meeting place of beauty, on the summit of heaven, in the place of Iḍā.
Let him partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship Tanūnapāt, the embryo of Aditi, the guardian of the world.
May the god today anoint with honey the paths that go to the gods for the gods.
Let him partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship Narāśaṃsa, praised by men, leader of men.
May he be rich in omentum through cows, powerful with heroes, first-going with chariots,
shining with gold.
Let him partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship Agni; praised by Iḍā, may the god bring the gods hither.
The unbewildered messenger, the bearer of oblations—may the god favor this sacrifice, favor this invocation of the gods.
Let him partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship the sacrificial grass, easily spread, soft as wool.
At this sacrifice let it spread out and forward, a good seat for the gods.
May the Vasus, Rudras, and Ādityas relish it today.
Let it be dear to Indra.
Let him partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship the lofty doors, wide-opening, moving toward the chest.
Let them raise themselves with their doorposts, let them open wide with their wings.
Easy of access at this sacrifice, increasing truth, let them spread wide.
Let them partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship Dawn and Night, the lofty ones, well adorned, making a womb for men and husbands;
smiling together with Indra, with the gods, let them sit upon this sacrificial grass.
Let the two partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship the divine Hotṛs, delightful, purifiers, wise poets, sagacious.
May one make [the sacrifice] well offered today with refreshment; may the other make it well completed with vigor.
Possessing equal strength, let them place this sacrifice in heaven among the gods.
Let the two partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship the three goddesses, most active among the active.
Let them weave this flawless work today,
goddesses for the gods, divine work.
Let them partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship Tvaṣṭṛ, the unperceived, remote, placer of seed, far-famed, placer of glory, multiform, not withholding desire.
May he be well nourished with nourishments, possessing good heroes with heroes.
Let him partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!
May the Hotṛ worship the tree; he will release [the offering], lover of prayer.
Men have labored.
The axe shall relish [it].
In due season today may the god, the oblation-bearer, [carry it] to the gods.
Let him partake of the ghee.
Hotṛ, worship!

4.13.3.s: samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ | ā ca vaha mitramahaś cakitvān tvaṃ dūtaḥ kavir asi pracetāḥ || tanūnapāt patha ṛtasya yānān madhvā samañjant svadayā sujihva | manmāni dhībhir uta yajñam ṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhy adhvaraṃ naḥ || narāśaṃsasya mahimānam eṣām upastoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ | ye sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyaṃdhāḥ svadantu devā ubhayāni havyā || ājuhvānā īḍyo vandyaś cāyāhy agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ | tvaṃ devānām asi yahva hotā sa enān yakṣīṣito yajīyān || prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastor asyā vṛjyate agre ahnām | vy u prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam || vyacasvatīr urviyā viśrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ | devīr dvāro bṛhatīr viśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ || ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau | divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne || daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai | pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā || ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyam etv iḍā manuṣvad iha cetayantī | tisro devīr barhir edaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu || ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī jantrī rūpair apiṃśad bhuvanāni viśvā | tam adya hotar iṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāram iha yakṣi vidvān || upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi | vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ||
4.13.3.d: समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे देवो देवान् यजसि जातवेदः । आ च वह मित्रमहश् चकित्वान् त्वं दूतः कविर् असि प्रचेताः ॥ तनूनपात् पथ ऋतस्य यानान् मध्वा समञ्जन्त् स्वदया सुजिह्व । मन्मानि धीभिर् उत यज्ञम् ऋन्धन् देवत्रा च कृणुह्य् अध्वरं नः ॥ नराशंसस्य महिमानम् एषाम् उपस्तोषाम यजतस्य यज्ञैः । ये सुक्रतवः शुचयो धियंधाः स्वदन्तु देवा उभयानि हव्या ॥ आजुह्वाना ईड्यो वन्द्यश् चायाह्य् अग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः । त्वं देवानाम् असि यह्व होता स एनान् यक्षीषितो यजीयान् ॥ प्राचीनं बर्हिः प्रदिशा पृथिव्या वस्तोर् अस्या वृज्यते अग्रे अह्नाम् । व्य् उ प्रथते वितरं वरीयो देवेभ्यो अदितये स्योनम् ॥ व्यचस्वतीर् उर्विया विश्रयन्तां पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः । देवीर् द्वारो बृहतीर् विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः ॥ आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ । दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने ॥ दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै । प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता ॥ आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयम् एत्व् इडा मनुष्वद् इह चेतयन्ती । तिस्रो देवीर् बर्हिर् एदं स्योनं सरस्वती स्वपसः सदन्तु ॥ य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जन्त्री रूपैर् अपिंशद् भुवनानि विश्वा । तम् अद्य होतर् इषितो यजीयान् देवं त्वष्टारम् इह यक्षि विद्वान् ॥ उपावसृज त्मन्या समञ्जन् देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि । वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन ॥
4.13.3.m:
Kindled today in the dwelling of man, a god, you worship the gods, O Jātavedas.
Bring them hither, friend-honored, perceptive one! You are the messenger, the poet, the sagacious.
O Tanūnapāt, anointing the paths going to truth with honey, make them sweet, O fair-tongued one;
furthering the thoughts with prayers and the sacrifice, place our rite among the gods.
We would praise with sacrifices the greatness of Narāśaṃsa, of these [gods], of the worshipful one;
may the gods, who possess good insight, pure, bestowing prayer, relish both oblations.
Invited, worthy of praise and homage, come, O Agni, in harmony with the Vasus.
You are the youthful Hotṛ of the gods; urged on, a better sacrificer, sacrifice to them!
The sacrificial grass is plucked eastward in the direction of the earth, at the lighting of this [dawn], in the forefront of days.
It spreads out wider, broad, comfortable for the gods, for Aditi.
Wide-reaching, let the divine doors open wide, adorning themselves like wives for their husbands;
lofty, all-impelling, become easy of access for the gods!
Moving gracefully, worshipful, close together, let Dawn and Night sit down upon the womb;
the two divine young women, lofty, shining brightly, assuming a beauty marked with light.
The two divine Hotṛs, first, of fair speech, fashioning the sacrifice for man to worship,
impelling the singers at the distributions [of gifts], pointing to the eastern light according to its direction.
May Bhāratī come swiftly to our sacrifice, and Iḍā, directing here like Manu;
let the three goddesses, Sarasvatī, of good works, sit upon this comfortable sacrificial grass.
He who fashioned these two, heaven and earth, the parents, who adorned all beings with forms,
to that divine Tvaṣṭṛ today, O Hotṛ, urged on, a better sacrificer, sacrifice here, knowing!
Release [the victim], anointing by yourself in due season the oblations along the path of the gods;
may the tree, the slaughterer, the divine Agni relish the oblation with honey and ghee!

4.13.4.s: agnir hotā no adhvare vājī san pariṇīyate | devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ || pari triviṣṭy adhvaraṃ yāty agnī rathīr iva | ā deveṣu prayo dadhat || pari vājapatiḥ kaviḥ || ajaid agnir asanad vājaṃ ni devo devebhyo havyāvāṭ prāñjobhir hinvāno dhenābhiḥ kalpamāno yajñasyāyuḥ pratirann upapreṣya hotar havyā devebhyo daivyāḥ śamitāra uta manuṣyā ārabhadhvam upanayata medhyā dura āśāsānā medhapataye medhaṃ prāsmā agniṃ bharata stṛṇīta barhir anv enaṃ mātā manyatām anu pitānu bhrātā saṃgarbhyo 'nu sakhā sayūthya udīcīnāṃ asya pado nidhattāt sūryaṃ cakṣur gamayatād vātaṃ prāṇam anvavasṛjatād antarkṣam asuṃ pṛthivīṃ śarīram ekadhāsya tvacam āchyatāt purā nābhyā apiśaso vapām utkhidatād antar evoṣmāṇaṃ vārayatāc chyenam asya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt praśasā bāhū śalā doṣaṇī kaśyapevāṃsāchidre śroṇī kavaṣorū srekaparṇāṣṭhīvantā ṣaḍviṃśatir asya vaṅkrayas tā anuṣṭhuyoccyāvayatād gātraṃgātram asyānūnaṃ kṛṇutād ūvadhyagohaṃ pārthivaṃ khanatād asnā rakṣaḥ saṃsṛjatād vaniṣṭum asya mā rāviṣṭorūkaṃ manyamānā ned vas toke tanaye ravitā ravad adhrigo śamīdhvaṃ suśami śamīdhvaṃ śamīdhvam adhrigo || adhriguś ca vipāpaś ca devānāṃ śamitārau | tā enaṃ pravidvāṃsau śrapayataṃ yathāsya śrapaṇaṃ tathā ||
4.13.4.d: अग्निर् होता नो अध्वरे वाजी सन् परिणीयते । देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः ॥ परि त्रिविष्ट्य् अध्वरं यात्य् अग्नी रथीर् इव । आ देवेषु प्रयो दधत् ॥ परि वाजपतिः कविः ॥ अजैद् अग्निर् असनद् वाजं नि देवो देवेभ्यो हव्यावाट् प्राञ्जोभिर् हिन्वानो धेनाभिः कल्पमानो यज्ञस्यायुः प्रतिरन्न् उपप्रेष्य होतर् हव्या देवेभ्यो दैव्याः शमितार उत मनुष्या आरभध्वम् उपनयत मेध्या दुर आशासाना मेधपतये मेधं प्रास्मा अग्निं भरत स्तृणीत बर्हिर् अन्व् एनं माता मन्यताम् अनु पितानु भ्राता संगर्भ्यो ऽनु सखा सयूथ्य उदीचीनां अस्य पदो निधत्तात् सूर्यं चक्षुर् गमयताद् वातं प्राणम् अन्ववसृजताद् अन्तर्क्षम् असुं पृथिवीं शरीरम् एकधास्य त्वचम् आछ्यतात् पुरा नाभ्या अपिशसो वपाम् उत्खिदताद् अन्तर् एवोष्माणं वारयताच् छ्येनम् अस्य वक्षः कृणुतात् प्रशसा बाहू शला दोषणी कश्यपेवांसाछिद्रे श्रोणी कवषोरू स्रेकपर्णाष्ठीवन्ता षड्विंशतिर् अस्य वङ्क्रयस् ता अनुष्ठुयोच्च्यावयताद् गात्रंगात्रम् अस्यानूनं कृणुताद् ऊवध्यगोहं पार्थिवं खनताद् अस्ना रक्षः संसृजताद् वनिष्टुम् अस्य मा राविष्टोरूकं मन्यमाना नेद् वस् तोके तनये रविता रवद् अध्रिगो शमीध्वं सुशमि शमीध्वं शमीध्वम् अध्रिगो ॥ अध्रिगुश् च विपापश् च देवानां शमितारौ । ता एनं प्रविद्वांसौ श्रपयतं यथास्य श्रपणं तथा ॥
4.13.4.m:
Agni, our Hotṛ at the rite, being the prize-winner, is led around,
a god worthy of sacrifice among the gods.
Agni goes around the rite three times like a charioteer,
placing delight among the gods.
Around, the lord of prizes, the poet.
Agni has won, he has gained the prize.
Down [sat] the god, the bearer of oblations for the gods,
impelled straight forward with might,
arranging himself with milk-streams,
lengthening the life of the sacrifice.
Hotṛ, summon [the gods] to the oblations!
Divine slaughterers and human ones, take hold!
Bring the sacrificial animals to the doors,
wishing the sacrificial offering for the lord of the sacrifice!
Bring Agni forward to him!
Strew the barhis!
May his mother consent to him, his father consent, his brother of the same womb consent,
his companion of the same herd consent!
Place his feet facing north!
Cause his eye to go to the sun!
Release his breath to the wind,
his life-spirit to the intermediate space,
his body to the earth!
Cut his skin in one piece!
Before cutting into the navel, tear out the omentum!
Keep his warmth within!
Make his breast [in the shape of] an eagle,
his arms two praśās,
his forearms two skewers,
his shoulders like two tortoises,
his hips unslit,
his thighs two kavāṣas,
his knee-caps two srekaparṇa leaves!
Twenty-six are his ribs;
detach them in regular order!
Make every limb of his whole!
Dig an earthen burial-place for the dung!
Unite the evil spirit with the blood!
Do not cut through his entrails,
thinking it an owl,
lest a howler howl among your children and offspring!
O Adhrigu, perform the slaughter!
Perform the slaughter with good slaughtering!
Perform the slaughter, O Adhrigu!
Adhrigu and Vipāpa are the two slaughterers of the gods;
knowing thoroughly, let the two cook him just as his cooking should be.

4.13.5.s: juṣasva saprathastamam || imaṃ no yajñam amṛteṣu dhehīmā havyā jātavedo juṣasva | stokānām agne medaso ghṛtasya hotaḥ prāśāna pahrathamo niṣadya || ghṛtavantaḥ pāvaka te stokāḥ ścotanti medasaḥ | svadharman devavītaye śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryam || tubhyaṃ stokā ghṛtaścuto 'gne viprāya santya | ṛṣiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samidhyase yajñasya prāvitā bhava || tubhyaṃ ścotanty adhrigo śacīvaḥ stokāso agne medaso ghṛtasya | kaviśasto bṛhatā bhānunāgā havyā juṣasva medhira || ojiṣṭhaṃ te madhyato medā udbhṛtaṃ pra te vayaṃ dadāmahe | ścotanti te vaso stokā adhi tvaci prati tān devaśo vihi || hotā yakṣad agniṃ svāhājyasya svāhā medasaḥ svāhā stokānāṃ svāhā svāhākṛtīnāṃ svāhā havyasūktīnāṃ svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇā agnā ājyasya vyantu hotar yaja || sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñam agnir devānām abhavat purogāḥ | asya hotuḥ pradiśy ṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ havir adantu devāḥ || agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanat || hotā yakṣad agnim ājyasya juṣatāṃ havir hotar yaja || tvaṃ somāsi satpatiḥ || hotā yakṣat somam ājyasya juṣatāṃ havir hotar yaja || śuciṃ nu stomam || hotā yakṣad indrāgnī chāgasya vapāyā medaso juṣetāṃ havir hotar yaja || śnathad vṛtram ubhā vām indrāgnī || hotā yakṣad indrāgnī puroḍāśasya juṣetāṃ havir hotar yaja || pra carṣaṇibhya iḍām agne hotā yakṣad agniṃ puroḍāśasya juṣatāṃ havir hotar yaja || agniṃ sudītiṃ sudṛśaṃ gṛṇanto namasyāmas tveḍyaṃ jātavedaḥ | tvāṃ dūtam aratiṃ havyavāhaṃ devā akṛṇvann amṛtasya nābhim || iḍopahūtopahūteḍopāsmaṃ iḍā hvayatām iḍopahūtā mānavī ghṛtapadī maitrāvaruṇī || brahma devakṛtam upahūtaṃ daivyā adhvaryavā upahūtā upahūtā manuṣyā ya imaṃ yajñam avān ye ca yajñapatiṃ vardhān upahūte dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvaje ṛtāvarī devī devaputre upahūto 'yaṃ yajamānā uttarasyāṃ devayajyāyām upahūto bhūyasi haviḥkaraṇe divye dhāmann upahūto devā ma idaṃ havir juṣantām iti tasminn upahūtaḥ ||
4.13.5.d: जुषस्व सप्रथस्तमम् ॥ इमं नो यज्ञम् अमृतेषु धेहीमा हव्या जातवेदो जुषस्व । स्तोकानाम् अग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य होतः प्राशान पह्रथमो निषद्य ॥ घृतवन्तः पावक ते स्तोकाः श्चोतन्ति मेदसः । स्वधर्मन् देववीतये श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यम् ॥ तुभ्यं स्तोका घृतश्चुतो ऽग्ने विप्राय सन्त्य । ऋषिः श्रेष्ठः समिध्यसे यज्ञस्य प्राविता भव ॥ तुभ्यं श्चोतन्त्य् अध्रिगो शचीवः स्तोकासो अग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य । कविशस्तो बृहता भानुनागा हव्या जुषस्व मेधिर ॥ ओजिष्ठं ते मध्यतो मेदा उद्भृतं प्र ते वयं ददामहे । श्चोतन्ति ते वसो स्तोका अधि त्वचि प्रति तान् देवशो विहि ॥ होता यक्षद् अग्निं स्वाहाज्यस्य स्वाहा मेदसः स्वाहा स्तोकानां स्वाहा स्वाहाकृतीनां स्वाहा हव्यसूक्तीनां स्वाहा देवा आज्यपा जुषाणा अग्ना आज्यस्य व्यन्तु होतर् यज ॥ सद्यो जातो व्यमिमीत यज्ञम् अग्निर् देवानाम् अभवत् पुरोगाः । अस्य होतुः प्रदिश्य् ऋतस्य वाचि स्वाहाकृतं हविर् अदन्तु देवाः ॥ अग्निर् वृत्राणि जङ्घनत् ॥ होता यक्षद् अग्निम् आज्यस्य जुषतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ त्वं सोमासि सत्पतिः ॥ होता यक्षत् सोमम् आज्यस्य जुषतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ शुचिं नु स्तोमम् ॥ होता यक्षद् इन्द्राग्नी छागस्य वपाया मेदसो जुषेतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ श्नथद् वृत्रम् उभा वाम् इन्द्राग्नी ॥ होता यक्षद् इन्द्राग्नी पुरोडाशस्य जुषेतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ प्र चर्षणिभ्य इडाम् अग्ने होता यक्षद् अग्निं पुरोडाशस्य जुषतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ अग्निं सुदीतिं सुदृशं गृणन्तो नमस्यामस् त्वेड्यं जातवेदः । त्वां दूतम् अरतिं हव्यवाहं देवा अकृण्वन्न् अमृतस्य नाभिम् ॥ इडोपहूतोपहूतेडोपास्मं इडा ह्वयताम् इडोपहूता मानवी घृतपदी मैत्रावरुणी ॥ ब्रह्म देवकृतम् उपहूतं दैव्या अध्वर्यवा उपहूता उपहूता मनुष्या य इमं यज्ञम् अवान् ये च यज्ञपतिं वर्धान् उपहूते द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वजे ऋतावरी देवी देवपुत्रे उपहूतो ऽयं यजमाना उत्तरस्यां देवयज्यायाम् उपहूतो भूयसि हविःकरणे दिव्ये धामन्न् उपहूतो देवा म इदं हविर् जुषन्ताम् इति तस्मिन्न् उपहूतः ॥
4.13.5.m:
Enjoy the most extensive one!
Place this sacrifice of ours among the immortals; relish these oblations, O Jātavedas!
Of the drops of fat and ghee, O Agni, O Hotṛ, sit down and eat first!
Full of ghee, O purifier, your drops of fat drip down;
in your own ordinance, for the feast of the gods, bestow upon us the best desirable treasure!
To you the drops dripping ghee [fall], O Agni, for the inspired, O holy one;
as the best ṛṣi you are kindled; become the protector of our sacrifice!
To you the drops of fat and ghee drip, O Adhrigu, O mighty one;
praised by poets, you have come with mighty radiance; relish the oblations, O wise one!
Your strongest fat is extracted from the middle; we offer it forward to you.
Drops drip for you, O Vasu, upon the skin; partake of them according to the gods!
May the Hotṛ worship Agni: Svāhā!
To the ghee, svāhā!
To the fat, svāhā!
To the drops, svāhā!
To the svāhā-utterances, svāhā!
To the well-spoken offerings, svāhā!
May the gods who drink ghee, enjoying Agni, partake of the ghee!
Hotṛ, worship!
Born just now, Agni measured out the sacrifice; he became the leader of the gods.
At the direction of this Hotṛ, at the voice of truth, let the gods eat the oblation made with svāhā!
Agni will strike down the obstacles.
May the Hotṛ worship Agni with ghee:
let him relish the oblation!
Hotṛ, worship!
You, O Soma, are the true protector.
May the Hotṛ worship Soma with ghee:
let him relish the oblation!
Hotṛ, worship!
Now a pure song of praise.
May the Hotṛ worship Indra and Agni with the omentum and fat of the he-goat:
let the two relish the oblation!
Hotṛ, worship!
May he strike Vṛtra!
Both of you, O Indra and Agni.
May the Hotṛ worship Indra and Agni with the rice-cake:
let the two relish the oblation!
Hotṛ, worship!
Forward for the peoples!
Iḍā, O Agni!
May the Hotṛ worship Agni with the rice-cake:
let him relish the oblation!
Hotṛ, worship!
Praising Agni of good brightness, fair to see, we pay homage to you, the worshipful Jātavedas;
the gods made you the messenger, the master, the bearer of oblations, the navel of immortality.
Iḍā is invoked.
Invoked is Iḍā.
May Iḍā invoke us!
Iḍā is invoked,
of Manu, having ghee on her feet, belonging to Mitra and Varuṇa.
The prayer made by the gods is invoked.
The two divine Adhvaryus are invoked,
the humans are invoked,
who shall protect this sacrifice and who shall make the lord of the sacrifice prosper.
Invoked are heaven and earth, first-born, keepers of truth, goddesses, having gods as sons.
Invoked is this sacrificer at the higher sacrifice to the gods,
invoked at the greater preparation of the oblation,
invoked in the heavenly realm:
‘May the gods relish this my oblation!’—
in that he is invoked.

4.13.6.s: tvaṃ hy agne prathamo manotāsyā dhiyo abhavo dasma hotā | tvaṃ sīṃ vṛṣann akṛṇor duṣṭarītu saho viśvasmai sahase sahadhyai || adhā hotā nyasīdo yajīyān iḍas pada iṣayann īḍyaḥ san | tvaṃ tvā naraḥ prathamaṃ devayanto maho rāye citayanto anugman || vṛteva yantaṃ bahubhir vasavyais tve rayiṃ jāgṛvāṃso anugman | ruśantam agniṃ darśataṃ bṛhantaṃ vapāvantaṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsam || padaṃ devasya namasā vyantaḥ śravasyavaḥ śrava āpann amṛktam | nāmāni cid dadhire yajñiyāni bhadrāyāṃ te raṇayanta saṃdṛṣṭau || tvāṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tvāṃ rāya ubhayāso janānām | tvaṃ trātā taraṇe cetyo bhūḥ pitā mātā sadam in mānuṣāṇām || saparyeṇyaḥ sa priyo vikṣv agnir hotā mandro niṣasādā yajīyān | taṃ tvā vayaṃ damā ā dīdivāṃsam upa jñubādho namasā sadema || taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudhyo navyam agne sumnāyava īmahe devayantaḥ | tvaṃ viśo anayo dīdyāno divo agne bṛhatā rocanena || viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ śaśvatīnāṃ nitośanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām | pretīṣaṇim iṣayantaṃ pāvakaṃ rājantam agniṃ yajataṃ rayīṇām || so agna īje śaśame ca marto yas tā ānaṭ samidhā havyadātim | ya āhutiṃ pari vedā namobhir viśvet sa vāmā dadhate tvotaḥ || asmā u te mahi mahe vidhema namobhir agne samidhota havyaiḥ | vedī sūno sahaso gīrbhir ukthair ā te bhadrāyāṃ sumatau yatema || ā yas tatantha rodasī vi bhāsā śravobhiś ca śravasyas tarutraḥ | bṛhadbhir vājaiḥ sthavirebhir asme revadbhir agne vitaraṃ vibhāhi || nṛvad vaso sadam id dhehy asme bhūri tokāya tanayāya paśvaḥ | pūrvīr iṣo bṛhatīr āreaghā asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu || purūṇy agne purudhā tvāyā vasūni rājan vasutā te aśyām | purūṇi hi tve puruvāra santy agne vasu vidhate rājani tve ||
4.13.6.d: त्वं ह्य् अग्ने प्रथमो मनोतास्या धियो अभवो दस्म होता । त्वं सीं वृषन्न् अकृणोर् दुष्टरीतु सहो विश्वस्मै सहसे सहध्यै ॥ अधा होता न्यसीदो यजीयान् इडस् पद इषयन्न् ईड्यः सन् । त्वं त्वा नरः प्रथमं देवयन्तो महो राये चितयन्तो अनुग्मन् ॥ वृतेव यन्तं बहुभिर् वसव्यैस् त्वे रयिं जागृवांसो अनुग्मन् । रुशन्तम् अग्निं दर्शतं बृहन्तं वपावन्तं विश्वहा दीदिवांसम् ॥ पदं देवस्य नमसा व्यन्तः श्रवस्यवः श्रव आपन्न् अमृक्तम् । नामानि चिद् दधिरे यज्ञियानि भद्रायां ते रणयन्त संदृष्टौ ॥ त्वां वर्धन्ति क्षितयः पृथिव्यां त्वां राय उभयासो जनानाम् । त्वं त्राता तरणे चेत्यो भूः पिता माता सदम् इन् मानुषाणाम् ॥ सपर्येण्यः स प्रियो विक्ष्व् अग्निर् होता मन्द्रो निषसादा यजीयान् । तं त्वा वयं दमा आ दीदिवांसम् उप ज्ञुबाधो नमसा सदेम ॥ तं त्वा वयं सुध्यो नव्यम् अग्ने सुम्नायव ईमहे देवयन्तः । त्वं विशो अनयो दीद्यानो दिवो अग्ने बृहता रोचनेन ॥ विशां कविं विश्पतिं शश्वतीनां नितोशनं वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् । प्रेतीषणिम् इषयन्तं पावकं राजन्तम् अग्निं यजतं रयीणाम् ॥ सो अग्न ईजे शशमे च मर्तो यस् ता आनट् समिधा हव्यदातिम् । य आहुतिं परि वेदा नमोभिर् विश्वेत् स वामा दधते त्वोतः ॥ अस्मा उ ते महि महे विधेम नमोभिर् अग्ने समिधोत हव्यैः । वेदी सूनो सहसो गीर्भिर् उक्थैर् आ ते भद्रायां सुमतौ यतेम ॥ आ यस् ततन्थ रोदसी वि भासा श्रवोभिश् च श्रवस्यस् तरुत्रः । बृहद्भिर् वाजैः स्थविरेभिर् अस्मे रेवद्भिर् अग्ने वितरं विभाहि ॥ नृवद् वसो सदम् इद् धेह्य् अस्मे भूरि तोकाय तनयाय पश्वः । पूर्वीर् इषो बृहतीर् आरेअघा अस्मे भद्रा सौश्रवसानि सन्तु ॥ पुरूण्य् अग्ने पुरुधा त्वाया वसूनि राजन् वसुता ते अश्याम् । पुरूणि हि त्वे पुरुवार सन्त्य् अग्ने वसु विधते राजनि त्वे ॥
4.13.6.m:
For you, O Agni, were the first thinker of this prayer; you became the Hotṛ, O wondrous one. / You, O bull, irresistible, made power to overcome all power.
Then as Hotṛ you sat down, more worthy of sacrifice, on the place of Iḍā, invigorating, being worthy of praise. / Men seeking the gods, discerning for great wealth, followed you first of all.
Following you who go with many treasures as if surrounded [by them], the watchful followed the wealth in you: / Agni, gleaming, lovely to look upon, lofty, rich in omentum, shining everywhere.
Going with homage to the footprint of the god, seeking fame, they attained unassailed fame. / They took indeed sacrifice-worthy names; they rejoiced in your auspicious sight.
The settlements on earth increase you; both kinds of wealth of peoples increase you. / You, O savior, have become noticeable as father [and] mother forever to mortals.
Worthy of service, dear among the peoples, Agni, the delightful Hotṛ, more worthy of sacrifice, has sat down. / To you, shining in the dwelling, we would sit near, bowing our knees with homage.
To you, Agni, we, of good thought, seeking favor, seeking the gods, pray anew. / You have guided the clans, shining forth from heaven, O Agni, with lofty radiance.
The poet of the clans, the lord of the perpetual clans, the crusher, the bull of peoples, / the swift-moving, the invigorating, the purifier, Agni, the worshipful king of riches.
That mortal has sacrificed and toiled, O Agni, who has brought to you a gift of oblation with fuel. / He who knows the offering round about with acts of homage—helped by you, he gains all desirable things.
To this great one we would pay great honor with acts of homage, O Agni, with fuel and with oblations; / on the altar, O son of strength, with songs and chants, we would strive for your auspicious goodwill.
You who have stretched out both worlds with brilliance, and with fame, seeking fame, overcoming, / with lofty, solid, rich prizes, O Agni, shine out further for us!
Give to us, O Vasu, always a bounty rich in men, abundant cattle for our children and lineage! / May many lofty refreshments with evils kept far away, auspicious glories, be ours!
Many goods in many ways through desire for you, O king, may I attain in your wealth, O Agni; / for in you, of many wishes, are many goods, in you, O king Agni, for the worshiper.

4.13.7.s: ā vṛtrahaṇā vṛtrahabhiḥ śuṣmair indra yātaṃ namobhir agne arvāk | yuvaṃ rādhobhir akavebhir indrāgne asme bhavatam uttamebhiḥ || hotā yakṣad indrāgnī chāgasya haviṣā āttām adya madhyato medā udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghastāṃ nūnaṃ ghāseajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānāṃ sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇām agniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasanānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato 'ṅgādaṅgād avattānāṃ karata evendrāgnī juṣetāṃ havir hotar yaja || gīrbhir vipraḥ pramatim ichamānā īṭṭe rayiṃ yaśasaṃ pūrvabhājam | indrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā suvajrā pra no navyebhis tirataṃ deṣṇaiḥ || devebhyo vanaspate havīṃṣi hiraṇyaparṇa pradivas te artham | pradakṣiṇid raśanayā niyūya ṛtasya vakṣi pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ || hotā yakṣad vanaspatim abhi hi piṣṭatamayā rabhiṣṭhayā raśanayādhita yatrāgner ājyasya priyā dhāmāni yatra somasyājyasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatrendrāgnyoś chāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra vanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsi yatra devānām ājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yatrāgner hotuḥ priyā dhāmāni tatraitaṃ prastutyevopastutyevopāvasrakṣad rabhīyāṃsam iva kṛtvī karad evaṃ devo vanaspatir juṣatāṃ havir hotar yaja || vanaspate raśanayā niyūya piṣṭatamayā vayunāni vidvān | vahā devatrā dadhiṣo havīṃṣi pra ca dātāram amṛteṣu vocaḥ || piprīhi devān || hotā yakṣad agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtam ayāḍ agnir agneḥ priyā dhāmāny ayāṭ somasyājyasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāny ayāḍ indrāgnyoś chāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāny ayāḍ vanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsy ayāḍ devānām ājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yakṣad agner hotuḥ priyā dhāmāni yakṣat svaṃ mahimānam āyajatām ejyā iṣaḥ kṛṇotu so adhvarāñ jātavedā juṣatāṃ havir hotar yaja || agne yad adyeḍopahūtā ||
4.13.7.d: आ वृत्रहणा वृत्रहभिः शुष्मैर् इन्द्र यातं नमोभिर् अग्ने अर्वाक् । युवं राधोभिर् अकवेभिर् इन्द्राग्ने अस्मे भवतम् उत्तमेभिः ॥ होता यक्षद् इन्द्राग्नी छागस्य हविषा आत्ताम् अद्य मध्यतो मेदा उद्भृतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घस्तां नूनं घासेअज्राणां यवसप्रथमानां सुमत्क्षराणां शतरुद्रियाणाम् अग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसनानां पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामत उत्सादतो ऽङ्गादङ्गाद् अवत्तानां करत एवेन्द्राग्नी जुषेतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ गीर्भिर् विप्रः प्रमतिम् इछमाना ईट्टे रयिं यशसं पूर्वभाजम् । इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहणा सुवज्रा प्र नो नव्येभिस् तिरतं देष्णैः ॥ देवेभ्यो वनस्पते हवींषि हिरण्यपर्ण प्रदिवस् ते अर्थम् । प्रदक्षिणिद् रशनया नियूय ऋतस्य वक्षि पथिभी रजिष्ठैः ॥ होता यक्षद् वनस्पतिम् अभि हि पिष्टतमया रभिष्ठया रशनयाधित यत्राग्नेर् आज्यस्य प्रिया धामानि यत्र सोमस्याज्यस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्रेन्द्राग्न्योश् छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्र वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांसि यत्र देवानाम् आज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि यत्राग्नेर् होतुः प्रिया धामानि तत्रैतं प्रस्तुत्येवोपस्तुत्येवोपावस्रक्षद् रभीयांसम् इव कृत्वी करद् एवं देवो वनस्पतिर् जुषतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ वनस्पते रशनया नियूय पिष्टतमया वयुनानि विद्वान् । वहा देवत्रा दधिषो हवींषि प्र च दातारम् अमृतेषु वोचः ॥ पिप्रीहि देवान् ॥ होता यक्षद् अग्निं स्विष्टकृतम् अयाड् अग्निर् अग्नेः प्रिया धामान्य् अयाट् सोमस्याज्यस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्य् अयाड् इन्द्राग्न्योश् छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्य् अयाड् वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांस्य् अयाड् देवानाम् आज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि यक्षद् अग्नेर् होतुः प्रिया धामानि यक्षत् स्वं महिमानम् आयजताम् एज्या इषः कृणोतु सो अध्वराञ् जातवेदा जुषतां हविर् होतर् यज ॥ अग्ने यद् अद्येडोपहूता ॥
4.13.7.m:
O slayers of Vṛtra, with your Vṛtra-slaying furies, O Indra and Agni, come hither with acts of homage! / O Indra and Agni, with superior, generous bounties, be with us!
May the Hotṛ worship Indra and Agni with the oblation of the goat! May they both eat today of the fat taken out from the middle, before enmities, before human seizure! May they now consume [portions] of those whose pasture is the plains, spreading over the grass, richly flowing, belonging to the hundred Rudras, tasted by Agni, whose garment is fat, cut off from the flank, from the thigh, from the liver, from the kidneys, limb by limb! Indra and Agni must indeed act; may they enjoy the oblation! / Hotṛ, worship!
With songs the inspired singer, seeking providence, praises wealth, glorious, holding the first share. / O Indra and Agni, slayers of Vṛtra, bearing good vajras, advance us with ever-new gifts!
O tree, golden-leaved, from of old your purpose is [to bear] oblations to the gods. / Fastening [them] around with a halter from left to right, convey [them] by the straightest paths of truth!
May the Hotṛ worship the tree! / For he has bound [it] around with the most adorned, swiftest halter, / where are the dear abodes of Agni’s melted butter, / where are the dear abodes of Soma’s melted-butter oblation, / where are the dear abodes of Indra-and-Agni’s goat oblation, / where are the dear sites of the tree, / where are the dear abodes of the melted-butter-drinking gods, / where are the dear abodes of Agni the Hotṛ, / there he will release this [offering], having as it were praised and hymned it. / Having made it as if stronger, the divine tree must indeed act; may he enjoy the oblation! / Hotṛ, worship!
O tree, having fastened [them] with the most adorned halter, knowing the ways, / carry the oblations, which you have received, to the gods, and announce the giver among the immortals!
Gladden the gods!
May the Hotṛ worship Agni Sviṣṭakṛt! / Agni has sacrificed to the dear abodes of Agni. / He has sacrificed to the dear abodes of Soma's melted-butter oblation. / He has sacrificed to the dear abodes of Indra-and-Agni's goat oblation. / He has sacrificed to the dear sites of the tree. / He has sacrificed to the dear abodes of the melted-butter-drinking gods. / He shall worship the dear abodes of Agni the Hotṛ. / He shall worship his own greatness. / May he win refreshments worthy of sacrifice! / May Jātavedas make the rites effective! / May he enjoy the oblation! / Hotṛ, worship!
What today, O Agni […] / Iḍā is invoked.

4.13.8.s: devaṃ barhiḥ sudevaṃ devaiḥ syāt suvīraṃ vīrair vastor vṛjyetāktoḥ prabhriyetāty anyān rāyā barhiṣmato madema vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja devaṃ barhir vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu devīr dvāraḥ saṃghāte vīḍvīr yāmañ śithirā dhruvā devahūtau vatsa īm enās taruṇā āmimīyāt kumāro vā navajāto mainā arvā reṇukakāṭaḥ praṇag vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja devīr dvāro vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu devī uṣāsānaktādyāsmin yajñe prayaty ahvetām api nūnaṃ daivīr viśaḥ prāyāsiṣṭāṃ suprīte sudhite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja devī uṣāsānaktā vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī yayor anyāghā dveṣāṃsi yūyavad ānyā vakṣad vasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja devī joṣṭrī vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ devī ūrjāhutī iṣam ūrjam anyā vakṣat sagdhiṃ sapītim anyā navena pūrvaṃ dayamānāḥ syāma purāṇena navaṃ tām ūrjam ūrjāhutī ūrjayamāne adhātāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja devī ūrjāhutī vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ devā daivyā hotārā potārā neṣṭārā hatāghaśaṃsā ābharadvasū vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja devā daivyā hotārā vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ devīs tisras tisro devīr iḍā sarasvatī bhāratī dyāṃ bhāraty ādityair aspṛkṣat sarasvatīmaṃ rudrair yajñam āvīd ihaiveḍayā vasumatyā sadhamādaṃ madema vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja devīs tisras tisro devīr vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu devo narāśaṃsas triśīrṣā ṣaḍakṣaḥ śatam id enaṃ śitipṛṣṭhā ādadhati sahasramīṃ pravahanti mitrāvaruṇed asya hotram arhato bṛhaspatiḥ stotram aśvinādhvaryavaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja devo narāśaṃso vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu devo vanaspatir varṣaprāvā ghṛtanirṇig dyām agreṇāspṛkṣad āntarikṣaṃ madhyenāprāḥ pṛthivīm upareṇādṛṃhīd vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja devo vanaspatir vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu devaṃ barhir vāritīnāṃ nidhedhāsi pracyutīnām apracyutaṃ nikāmadharaṇaṃ puruṣaspārhaṃ yaśasvad enā barhiṣānyā barhīṃṣy abhiṣyāma vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja devaṃ barhir vāritīnāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛd yaja devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛt ||
4.13.8.d: देवं बर्हिः सुदेवं देवैः स्यात् सुवीरं वीरैर् वस्तोर् वृज्येताक्तोः प्रभ्रियेतात्य् अन्यान् राया बर्हिष्मतो मदेम वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज देवं बर्हिर् वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु देवीर् द्वारः संघाते वीड्वीर् यामञ् शिथिरा ध्रुवा देवहूतौ वत्स ईम् एनास् तरुणा आमिमीयात् कुमारो वा नवजातो मैना अर्वा रेणुककाटः प्रणग् वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज देवीर् द्वारो वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु देवी उषासानक्ताद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे प्रयत्य् अह्वेताम् अपि नूनं दैवीर् विशः प्रायासिष्टां सुप्रीते सुधिते वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज देवी उषासानक्ता वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां देवी जोष्ट्री वसुधिती ययोर् अन्याघा द्वेषांसि यूयवद् आन्या वक्षद् वसु वार्याणि यजमानाय वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज देवी जोष्ट्री वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां देवी ऊर्जाहुती इषम् ऊर्जम् अन्या वक्षत् सग्धिं सपीतिम् अन्या नवेन पूर्वं दयमानाः स्याम पुराणेन नवं ताम् ऊर्जम् ऊर्जाहुती ऊर्जयमाने अधातां वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज देवी ऊर्जाहुती वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां देवा दैव्या होतारा पोतारा नेष्टारा हताघशंसा आभरद्वसू वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज देवा दैव्या होतारा वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां देवीस् तिस्रस् तिस्रो देवीर् इडा सरस्वती भारती द्यां भारत्य् आदित्यैर् अस्पृक्षत् सरस्वतीमं रुद्रैर् यज्ञम् आवीद् इहैवेडया वसुमत्या सधमादं मदेम वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज देवीस् तिस्रस् तिस्रो देवीर् वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु देवो नराशंसस् त्रिशीर्षा षडक्षः शतम् इद् एनं शितिपृष्ठा आदधति सहस्रमीं प्रवहन्ति मित्रावरुणेद् अस्य होत्रम् अर्हतो बृहस्पतिः स्तोत्रम् अश्विनाध्वर्यवं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज देवो नराशंसो वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु देवो वनस्पतिर् वर्षप्रावा घृतनिर्णिग् द्याम् अग्रेणास्पृक्षद् आन्तरिक्षं मध्येनाप्राः पृथिवीम् उपरेणादृंहीद् वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज देवो वनस्पतिर् वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु देवं बर्हिर् वारितीनां निधेधासि प्रच्युतीनाम् अप्रच्युतं निकामधरणं पुरुषस्पार्हं यशस्वद् एना बर्हिषान्या बर्हींष्य् अभिष्याम वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज देवं बर्हिर् वारितीनां वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृद् यज देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृत् ॥
4.13.8.m: May the divine barhis be rich in gods through the gods, / rich in heroes through heroes! / In the morning let it be strewn; / at night let it be brought forward! / May we rejoice surpassing others in wealth, possessing barhis! / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The divine barhis: / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / The divine doors, firm in collision, slack in passing, steadfast at the invocation of the gods; / may a tender calf or a newborn boy suckle them; / let not a horse kicking up dust touch them! / For the winning of wealth, may they partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The divine doors: / For the winning of wealth, may they partake of the treasure-foundation! / The divine Dawn and Night have now called out at the proceeding of this sacrifice; / now indeed may the divine clans go forward, well-pleased, well-placed! / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The divine Dawn and Night: / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / The two divine loving ones, guardians of wealth, of whom one shall ward off sins and enmities, and the other shall bring desirable goods for the sacrificer! / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The two divine loving ones: / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / The two divine invocations of vigor: may one bring nourishment and vigor, and the other common eating and common drinking! / With the new may we be sparing of the old, with the old of the new! / That vigor the two invocations of vigor, bestowing vigor, established! / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The two divine invocations of vigor: / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / The two divine Hotṛs, Potṛs, Neṣṭṛs, slayers of the evil-speaker, bringing wealth! / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The two divine Hotṛs: / For the winning of wealth, may the two partake of the treasure-foundation! / The three goddesses, the three goddesses: Iḍā, Sarasvatī, Bhāratī! / Bhāratī has touched heaven with the Ādityas; / Sarasvatī has aided this sacrifice with the Rudras; / right here with Iḍā possessing goods may we revel together! / For the winning of wealth, may they partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The three goddesses, the three goddesses: / For the winning of wealth, may they partake of the treasure-foundation! / The divine Narāśaṃsa, three-headed, six-eyed: / a hundred white-backed ones support him, / a thousand carry him forward! / Mitra and Varuṇa are worthy of his Hotṛ-ship, / Bṛhaspati of the chant of praise, / the two Aśvins of the Adhvaryu-ship! / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The divine Narāśaṃsa: / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / The divine tree, favoring rain, robed in ghee, has touched heaven with its top; / with its middle it has filled the atmosphere; / with its base it has made firm the earth! / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The divine tree: / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / The divine barhis of the streams, foundation of foundations, unfallen among fallen things, holding at wish, desirable to men, glorious! / With this barhis may we overcome other barhises! / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / Sacrifice! / The divine barhis of the streams: / For the winning of wealth, may he partake of the treasure-foundation! / The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt! / Sacrifice! / The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt!

4.13.9.s: agnim adya hotāram avṛṇītāyaṃ yajamānaḥ pacan paktīḥ pacan puroḍāśaṃ gṛhṇann agnayā ājyaṃ gṛhṇant somāyājyaṃ badhnann indrāgnibhyāṃ chāgaṃ sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatir abhavad agnayā ājyena somāyājyenendrāgnibhyāṃ chāgenāghastāṃ taṃ medastaḥ pratipacatāgrabhīṣṭām avīvṛdhetāṃ puroḍāśena tvām adya ṛṣa ārṣeya ṛṣīṇāṃ napād avṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāno bahubhyā ā saṃgatebhya eṣa me deveṣu vasu vāryāyakṣyatā iti tā yā devā devadānāny adus tāny asmā ā ca śāsvā ca gurasveṣitaś ca hotar asi bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhīdaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī bhadram abhūd ārdhma sūktavākam uta namovākam ṛdhyāsma sūktocyam agne tvaṃ sūktavāg asy upaśruti divas pṛthivyor omanvatī te 'smin yajñe yajamāna dyāvāpṛthivī stāṃ śaṃgavī jīradānū atrasnū apravede asaṃbādhe urugavyūtī abhayaṃkṛtau vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpā śaṃbhuvau mayobhuvaūrjasvatī ca payasvatī ca sūpacaraṇā ca svadhicaraṇā ca tayor āvidy agnir idaṃ havir ajuṣatāvīvṛdhata maho jyāyo 'kṛta soma idaṃ havir ajuṣatāvīvṛdhata maho jyāyo 'kṛtendrāgnī idaṃ havir ajuṣetām avīvṛdhetāṃ maho jyāyo 'krātāṃ vanaspatir idaṃ havir ajuṣatāvīvṛdhata maho jyāyo 'kṛta devā ājyapā ājyam ajuṣantāvīvṛdhanta maho jyāyo 'krata agnir hotreṇedaṃ havir ajuṣatāvīvṛdhata maho jyāyo 'kṛtāsyām ṛdhad dhotrāyāṃ devaṃgamāyām āśāste 'yaṃ yajamāna āyur āśāste suprajāstvam āśāste viśvaṃ priyam āśāste yad anena haviṣāśāste tad aśyāt tad ṛdhyāt tad asmai devā rāsantāṃ tad agnir devo devebhyo vanutāṃ vayam agner mānuṣā iṣṭaṃ ca vītaṃ cobhe ca no dyāvāpṛthivī aṃhasas pātām eha gatir vāmasyedaṃ namo devebhyaḥ ||
4.13.9.d: अग्निम् अद्य होतारम् अवृणीतायं यजमानः पचन् पक्तीः पचन् पुरोडाशं गृह्णन्न् अग्नया आज्यं गृह्णन्त् सोमायाज्यं बध्नन्न् इन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागं सूपस्था अद्य देवो वनस्पतिर् अभवद् अग्नया आज्येन सोमायाज्येनेन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागेनाघस्तां तं मेदस्तः प्रतिपचताग्रभीष्टाम् अवीवृधेतां पुरोडाशेन त्वाम् अद्य ऋष आर्षेय ऋषीणां नपाद् अवृणीतायं यजमानो बहुभ्या आ संगतेभ्य एष मे देवेषु वसु वार्यायक्ष्यता इति ता या देवा देवदानान्य् अदुस् तान्य् अस्मा आ च शास्वा च गुरस्वेषितश् च होतर् असि भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रूहीदं द्यावापृथिवी भद्रम् अभूद् आर्ध्म सूक्तवाकम् उत नमोवाकम् ऋध्यास्म सूक्तोच्यम् अग्ने त्वं सूक्तवाग् अस्य् उपश्रुति दिवस् पृथिव्योर् ओमन्वती ते ऽस्मिन् यज्ञे यजमान द्यावापृथिवी स्तां शंगवी जीरदानू अत्रस्नू अप्रवेदे असंबाधे उरुगव्यूती अभयंकृतौ वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापा शंभुवौ मयोभुवऊर्जस्वती च पयस्वती च सूपचरणा च स्वधिचरणा च तयोर् आविद्य् अग्निर् इदं हविर् अजुषतावीवृधत महो ज्यायो ऽकृत सोम इदं हविर् अजुषतावीवृधत महो ज्यायो ऽकृतेन्द्राग्नी इदं हविर् अजुषेताम् अवीवृधेतां महो ज्यायो ऽक्रातां वनस्पतिर् इदं हविर् अजुषतावीवृधत महो ज्यायो ऽकृत देवा आज्यपा आज्यम् अजुषन्तावीवृधन्त महो ज्यायो ऽक्रत अग्निर् होत्रेणेदं हविर् अजुषतावीवृधत महो ज्यायो ऽकृतास्याम् ऋधद् धोत्रायां देवंगमायाम् आशास्ते ऽयं यजमान आयुर् आशास्ते सुप्रजास्त्वम् आशास्ते विश्वं प्रियम् आशास्ते यद् अनेन हविषाशास्ते तद् अश्यात् तद् ऋध्यात् तद् अस्मै देवा रासन्तां तद् अग्निर् देवो देवेभ्यो वनुतां वयम् अग्नेर् मानुषा इष्टं च वीतं चोभे च नो द्यावापृथिवी अंहसस् पाताम् एह गतिर् वामस्येदं नमो देवेभ्यः ॥
4.13.9.m: Today this sacrificer has chosen Agni as Hotṛ, cooking the cooked dishes, cooking the sacrificial cake, scooping ghee for Agni, scooping ghee for Soma, binding the goat for Indra and Agni. / Today the divine tree has been a good lap, with ghee for Agni, with ghee for Soma, with the goat for Indra and Agni. / They have eaten it; / from the fat they have roasted [the portions]; / they have taken [them]; / they have magnified themselves with the sacrificial cake. / Today, O seer, descendant of seers, grandchild of seers, this sacrificer has chosen you / from many assembled together, thinking: ‘He shall sacrifice for me among the gods for desirable goods.’ / Those divine gifts that the gods gave, those command and approve for him! / You have been impelled, O Hotṛ, to speak auspiciously; as a mortal you are urged to the Sūktavāka; / speak the well-spoken words! / ‘This has become auspicious, O Heaven and Earth!’ / May we succeed in the Sūktavāka and the Namovāka; / may we succeed in the utterance of the hymn! / O Agni, you are the speaker of the hymn, in the hearing of Heaven and Earth! / May Heaven and Earth be helpful to you in this sacrifice, O sacrificer: / bringing blessings to cattle, with swift-flowing bounties, / fearless, untrembling, unconstricted, / of wide pasture, creating security, / raining from heaven, with flowing waters, / causing welfare, causing delight, / rich in vigor and rich in milk, / easy of access and rich in independent movement, / in their knowledge! / Agni has enjoyed this oblation; / he has magnified himself; / he has made great greatness. / Soma has enjoyed this oblation; / he has magnified himself; / he has made great greatness. / Indra and Agni have enjoyed this oblation; / they have magnified themselves; / they have made great greatness. / The tree has enjoyed this oblation; / it has magnified itself; / it has made great greatness. / The gods who drink ghee have enjoyed the ghee; / they have magnified themselves; / they have made great greatness. / Agni through his Hotṛ-ship has enjoyed this oblation; / he has magnified himself; / he has made great greatness. / In this divine-going Hotṛ-office may he prosper! / This sacrificer prays: / he prays for life; / he prays for good offspring; / he prays for all that is dear. / What he prays for with this oblation, that may he attain; / that may he achieve; / that may the gods bestow upon him; / that may the god Agni win from the gods! / We are the mortals of Agni. / [May there be] what is sacrificed and what is enjoyed! / And may both Heaven and Earth protect us from distress! / Hither is the path of the desirable treasure! / This homage to the gods!”

4.13.10.s: tañ śaṃyor āvṛṇīmahe gātuṃ yajñāya gātuṃ yajñapataye daivī svastir astu naḥ savastir mānuṣebhyaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ jigātu bheṣajaṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade || āpyāyasva saṃ te payāṃsi || iha tvaṣṭāram agriyaṃ viśvarūpam upahvaye | asmākam astu kevalaḥ || tan nas turīpam adha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭar vi rarāṇaḥ syasva | yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ || devānāṃ patnīr uśatīr avantu naḥ prāvantu nas tujaye vājasātaye | yāḥ pārthivāso yā apām api vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yachata || uta gnā vyantu devapatnīr indrāṇy agnāyy aśvinī rāṭ | ā rodaṣī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīr ya ṛtur janīnām || rākām ahaṃ yās te rāke sinīvāli yā supāṇiḥ kuhūm ahaṃ kuhūr devānām || agnir hotā gṛhapatiḥ sa rājā viśvā veda janimā jātavedāḥ | devānām uta yo martyānāṃ yajiṣṭhaḥ sa prayajatām ṛtāvā || havyavāḍ agnir iḍopahūtā ||
4.13.10.d: तञ् शंयोर् आवृणीमहे गातुं यज्ञाय गातुं यज्ञपतये दैवी स्वस्तिर् अस्तु नः सवस्तिर् मानुषेभ्यः । ऊर्ध्वं जिगातु भेषजं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥ आप्यायस्व सं ते पयांसि ॥ इह त्वष्टारम् अग्रियं विश्वरूपम् उपह्वये । अस्माकम् अस्तु केवलः ॥ तन् नस् तुरीपम् अध पोषयित्नु देव त्वष्टर् वि रराणः स्यस्व । यतो वीरः कर्मण्यः सुदक्षो युक्तग्रावा जायते देवकामः ॥ देवानां पत्नीर् उशतीर् अवन्तु नः प्रावन्तु नस् तुजये वाजसातये । याः पार्थिवासो या अपाम् अपि व्रते ता नो देवीः सुहवाः शर्म यछत ॥ उत ग्ना व्यन्तु देवपत्नीर् इन्द्राण्य् अग्नाय्य् अश्विनी राट् । आ रोदषी वरुणानी शृणोतु व्यन्तु देवीर् य ऋतुर् जनीनाम् ॥ राकाम् अहं यास् ते राके सिनीवालि या सुपाणिः कुहूम् अहं कुहूर् देवानाम् ॥ अग्निर् होता गृहपतिः स राजा विश्वा वेद जनिमा जातवेदाः । देवानाम् उत यो मर्त्यानां यजिष्ठः स प्रयजताम् ऋतावा ॥ हव्यवाड् अग्निर् इडोपहूता ॥
4.13.10.m:
We choose that welfare and blessing, a path for the sacrifice, a path for the lord of the sacrifice.
May there be divine well-being for us, well-being for men!
May healing go upward! Welfare be for us to the two-footed, welfare to the four-footed!
Swell up!
Gathered unto you be the milk-streams!
Here I invoke Tvaṣṭṛ, the foremost, multiform;
let him be ours alone.
Grant us that semen, then, O god Tvaṣṭṛ, nourishing, being gracious, / from which a hero is born, skillful, very capable, operating the pressing-stones, god-loving!
May the willing wives of the gods favor us, may they favor us for offspring, for the winning of prize!
Those who are of the earth, those who are also in the realm of the waters, may those easily-invoked goddesses grant us protection!
And may the divine women, the wives of the gods, feast: Indrāṇī, Agnāyī, the ruler Aśvinī;
may Rodasī, Varuṇānī listen; may the goddesses partake at the proper season of the wives!
I [invoke] Rākā.
Those which are yours, O Rākā—
O Sinīvālī—
She who has fair hands—
I [invoke] Kuhū.
Kuhū of the gods—
Agni is Hotṛ, householder, he the king knows all races, Jātavedas.
Most worshipful among the gods and mortals, let him sacrifice, the order-true!
Agni, bearer of oblations—
Iḍā is invoked.

4.14.1.s: somo dhenuṃ somo arvantam āśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadāti | sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyaṃ pitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśad asmai || aṣāḍhaṃ yutsu pṛtanāsu papriṃ svarṣām apsāṃ vṛjanasya gopām | bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasaṃ jayantaṃ tvām anumadema soma || tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ sukratur bhūs tvaṃ dakṣaiḥ sudakṣo viśvavedāḥ | tvaṃ vṛṣā vṛṣatvebhir mahitvā dyumnebhir dyumny abhavo nṛcakṣāḥ || yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyām || tvam imā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvās tvam apo ajanayas tvaṃ gāḥ | tvam ātatanthorv antarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha || yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti somāpūṣaṇemau devau || somāpūṣaṇā rajaso vimānaṃ saptacakraṃ ratham aviśvaminvam | viṣūvṛtaṃ manasā yujyamānaṃ taṃ jinvatho vṛṣaṇā pañcaraśmim || divy anyaḥ sadanaṃ cakra uccā pṛthivyām anyo adhy antarikṣe | tā asmabhyaṃ puruvāraṃ purukṣuṃ rāyas poṣaṃ viṣyatāṃ nābhim asme || dhiyaṃ pūṣā jinvatu viśvaminvo rayiṃ somo rayipatir dadhātu || avatu devy aditir anarvā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ || viśvāny anyo bhuvanā jajāna viśvam anyo abhicakṣāṇa eti | somāpūṣaṇā avataṃ dhiyaṃ me yuvābhyāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayema || prajāpate nahi tvat tāny anyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva | yasmai kaṃ juhumas tan no astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām || rayīṇāṃ patiṃ yajataṃ bṛhantam asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | prajāpatiṃ prathamajām ṛtasya yajāma devam adhi no bravītu || prajāpate tvaṃ nidhipāḥ purāṇo devānāṃ pitā janitā prajānām | patir viśvasya jagataḥ paraspā havir no deva vihave juṣasva || taveme lokāḥ pradiśo diśaś ca parāvato nivata udvataś ca | prajāpate viśvasṛg jīvadhanya idaṃ no deva pratiharya havyam || prajāpatiṃ prathamaṃ yajñiyānāṃ devānām agre yajataṃ yajadhvam | sa no dadātu śravaṇaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tasmai te deva haviṣā vidhema || yo rāya īśe śatadāya ukthyo yaḥ paśūnāṃ rakṣitā viṣṭhitānām | prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya sahasradhāmā juṣatāṃ havir naḥ ||
4.14.1.d: सोमो धेनुं सोमो अर्वन्तम् आशुं सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददाति । सादन्यं विदथ्यं सभेयं पितृश्रवणं यो ददाशद् अस्मै ॥ अषाढं युत्सु पृतनासु पप्रिं स्वर्षाम् अप्सां वृजनस्य गोपाम् । भरेषुजां सुक्षितिं सुश्रवसं जयन्तं त्वाम् अनुमदेम सोम ॥ त्वं सोम क्रतुभिः सुक्रतुर् भूस् त्वं दक्षैः सुदक्षो विश्ववेदाः । त्वं वृषा वृषत्वेभिर् महित्वा द्युम्नेभिर् द्युम्न्य् अभवो नृचक्षाः ॥ या ते धामानि दिवि या पृथिव्याम् ॥ त्वम् इमा ओषधीः सोम विश्वास् त्वम् अपो अजनयस् त्वं गाः । त्वम् आततन्थोर्व् अन्तरिक्षं त्वं ज्योतिषा वि तमो ववर्थ ॥ या ते धामानि हविषा यजन्ति सोमापूषणेमौ देवौ ॥ सोमापूषणा रजसो विमानं सप्तचक्रं रथम् अविश्वमिन्वम् । विषूवृतं मनसा युज्यमानं तं जिन्वथो वृषणा पञ्चरश्मिम् ॥ दिव्य् अन्यः सदनं चक्र उच्चा पृथिव्याम् अन्यो अध्य् अन्तरिक्षे । ता अस्मभ्यं पुरुवारं पुरुक्षुं रायस् पोषं विष्यतां नाभिम् अस्मे ॥ धियं पूषा जिन्वतु विश्वमिन्वो रयिं सोमो रयिपतिर् दधातु ॥ अवतु देव्य् अदितिर् अनर्वा बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥ विश्वान्य् अन्यो भुवना जजान विश्वम् अन्यो अभिचक्षाण एति । सोमापूषणा अवतं धियं मे युवाभ्यां विश्वाः पृतना जयेम ॥ प्रजापते नहि त्वत् तान्य् अन्यो विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव । यस्मै कं जुहुमस् तन् नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥ रयीणां पतिं यजतं बृहन्तम् अस्मिन् भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । प्रजापतिं प्रथमजाम् ऋतस्य यजाम देवम् अधि नो ब्रवीतु ॥ प्रजापते त्वं निधिपाः पुराणो देवानां पिता जनिता प्रजानाम् । पतिर् विश्वस्य जगतः परस्पा हविर् नो देव विहवे जुषस्व ॥ तवेमे लोकाः प्रदिशो दिशश् च परावतो निवत उद्वतश् च । प्रजापते विश्वसृग् जीवधन्य इदं नो देव प्रतिहर्य हव्यम् ॥ प्रजापतिं प्रथमं यज्ञियानां देवानाम् अग्रे यजतं यजध्वम् । स नो ददातु श्रवणं पितॄणां तस्मै ते देव हविषा विधेम ॥ यो राय ईशे शतदाय उक्थ्यो यः पशूनां रक्षिता विष्ठितानाम् । प्रजापतिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य सहस्रधामा जुषतां हविर् नः ॥
4.14.1.m:
Soma gives a milch-cow, Soma a swift courser, Soma a skillful hero, / domestic, fit for assembly, fit for council, bringing fame to his father, to him who serves him.
Unconquered in battles, carrying through in fights, winning heaven, winning water, guardian of the clan, / born in contests, possessing good dwelling, of good fame, conquering, may we rejoice along with you, O Soma!
You, O Soma, have become of good insight through your insights, very capable through your capacities, knowing all;
you, a bull through bull-powers, by greatness, radiant with splendors, having an eye for men.
Those abodes of yours in heaven, those on earth—
You, O Soma, generated all these plants, you the waters, you the cows;
you stretched out the wide atmosphere, you uncovered the darkness with light.
Those abodes of yours they worship with oblation—
O Soma and Pūṣan—
These two gods—
O Soma and Pūṣan, the measurer of space, the seven-wheeled chariot that does not reach everyone, / revolving on both sides, yoked by the mind, you two bulls impel that five-reined [chariot].
The one has made his seat high in heaven, the other on earth [and] over the atmosphere;
may they two loosen for us that navel possessing much choice [goods], rich in food, the increase of wealth.
May Pūṣan, reaching everyone, quicken our poetic thought; may Soma, lord of wealth, bestow wealth!
May the goddess Aditi, unhindered, favor us; may we, with good heroes, speak great [things] at the assembly!
The one has generated all beings; the other goes beholding all;
O Soma and Pūṣan, favor my poetic thought; with you two may we conquer all battles!
O Prajāpati, no other than you has embraced all these generated things;
for whatever desire we sacrifice to you, let that be ours; may we be lords of riches!
The lord of riches, the worshipful, the great, the most manly in this contest for the winning of prize, / Prajāpati, the firstborn of truth, let us worship; may the god speak for us!
O Prajāpati, you are the ancient guardian of treasure, father of the gods, begetter of offspring;
lord of the whole world, highest protector, enjoy our oblation, O god, at the invocation!
Yours are these worlds, the intermediate directions and the directions, the distances, the depths, and the heights;
O Prajāpati, creator of the all, rich in life, accept this our oblation, O god!
Worship Prajāpati, the first of the worshipful gods, at the beginning, worship [him]!
May he give us the fame of the fathers; to that god let us serve with oblation!
Who rules over wealth, hundred-granting, worthy of praise, who is the protector of distributed cattle, / Prajāpati, the firstborn of truth, possessing a thousand abodes, may he enjoy our oblation!

4.14.2.s: vāyo śataṃ harīṇāṃ yuvasva poṣyāṇām | uta vā te sahasriṇo rathā āyātu pājasā || īśānāya prahutiṃ yas tā ānaṭ śuciṃ somaṃ śucipās tubhyaṃ vāyo | kṛṇoṣi taṃ martyeṣu praśastaṃ jātojāto jāyate vājy asya || yukṣvā hi tvaṃ rathāsahā yuvasva poṣyā vaso | ān no vāyo madhu pibāsmākaṃ savanāgahi || kuvid aṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsaḥ purā devā anavadyāsā āsan | te vāyave manave bādhitāyāvāsayann uṣasaṃ sūryeṇa || ā no vāyo mahe tane yāhi makhāya pājase | vayaṃ hi te cakṛmā bhūri dāvane sadyaś cin mahi dāvane || saṃ te vāyuḥ || pīvoannaṃ rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutām abhiśrīḥ | te vāyave samanaso vitasthur viśven naraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ || rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam | adha vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke || ā vāyo pra vāyuṃ pra yābhiḥ || ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhir adhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhir upayāhi yajñam | vāyo asmint savane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ || devānāṃ bhadrā sumatir ṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātir abhi no nivartatām | devānāṃ sakhyam upasedimā vayaṃ devā nā āyuḥ pratirantu jīvase || bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhir yajatrāḥ | sthirair aṅgais tuṣṭuvāṃsas tanūbhir vyaśema devahitaṃ yad āyuḥ || śatam in nu śarado anti devā yatrā naś cakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām | putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyur gantoḥ || ā vo devāsa īmahe || uta devā avahitaṃ devā unnayathā punaḥ | utāgaś cakruṣaṃ devā devā jīvayathā punaḥ || yajñena yajñam ayajanta devāḥ ||
4.14.2.d: वायो शतं हरीणां युवस्व पोष्याणाम् । उत वा ते सहस्रिणो रथा आयातु पाजसा ॥ ईशानाय प्रहुतिं यस् ता आनट् शुचिं सोमं शुचिपास् तुभ्यं वायो । कृणोषि तं मर्त्येषु प्रशस्तं जातोजातो जायते वाज्य् अस्य ॥ युक्ष्वा हि त्वं रथासहा युवस्व पोष्या वसो । आन् नो वायो मधु पिबास्माकं सवनागहि ॥ कुविद् अङ्ग नमसा ये वृधासः पुरा देवा अनवद्यासा आसन् । ते वायवे मनवे बाधितायावासयन्न् उषसं सूर्येण ॥ आ नो वायो महे तने याहि मखाय पाजसे । वयं हि ते चकृमा भूरि दावने सद्यश् चिन् महि दावने ॥ सं ते वायुः ॥ पीवोअन्नं रयिवृधः सुमेधाः श्वेतः सिषक्ति नियुताम् अभिश्रीः । ते वायवे समनसो वितस्थुर् विश्वेन् नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः ॥ राये नु यं जज्ञतू रोदसीमे राये देवी धिषणा धाति देवम् । अध वायुं नियुतः सश्चत स्वा उत श्वेतं वसुधितिं निरेके ॥ आ वायो प्र वायुं प्र याभिः ॥ आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिर् अध्वरं सहस्रिणीभिर् उपयाहि यज्ञम् । वायो अस्मिन्त् सवने मादयस्व यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥ देवानां भद्रा सुमतिर् ऋजूयतां देवानां रातिर् अभि नो निवर्तताम् । देवानां सख्यम् उपसेदिमा वयं देवा ना आयुः प्रतिरन्तु जीवसे ॥ भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर् यजत्राः । स्थिरैर् अङ्गैस् तुष्टुवांसस् तनूभिर् व्यशेम देवहितं यद् आयुः ॥ शतम् इन् नु शरदो अन्ति देवा यत्रा नश् चक्रा जरसं तनूनाम् । पुत्रासो यत्र पितरो भवन्ति मा नो मध्या रीरिषतायुर् गन्तोः ॥ आ वो देवास ईमहे ॥ उत देवा अवहितं देवा उन्नयथा पुनः । उतागश् चक्रुषं देवा देवा जीवयथा पुनः ॥ यज्ञेन यज्ञम् अयजन्त देवाः ॥
4.14.2.m:
O Vāyu, yoke a hundred bays, well-nourished,
or let your chariot with a thousand [horses] come with power!
Whoever has offered an oblation to you the ruler, the bright Soma to you, O drinker of the bright, O Vāyu,
him you make praised among mortals; son after son of his is born a prize-winner.
For yoke the two chariot-bearing steeds, yoke the well-nourished ones, O Vasu!
Come, O Vāyu, drink our sweet juice, come to our pressings!
Surely, indeed, those faultless gods of old who were magnified with homage, / they, for Vāyu [and] for troubled Manu, made the dawn shine forth with the sun.
Come to us, O Vāyu, for great offspring, for the sacrifice, with power!
For we have prepared for you much for giving, immediately indeed much for giving.
Together with you, Vāyu—
Rich in food, increaser of wealth, very wise, white, he follows the splendor of the teams;
they, united in mind, have stood up for Vāyu; all the men have gained good offspring.
For wealth now these two Rodasīs generated [him], for wealth the divine Dhiṣaṇā establishes the god;
then his own teams attend Vāyu, and the white guardian of wealth in isolation.
Come, O Vāyu—
Forward, to Vāyu—
Forward, with which—
Come to our rite with teams by hundreds, to our sacrifice with [teams] by thousands!
O Vāyu, exhilarate yourself at this pressing; protect us always with your blessings!
May the auspicious goodwill of the gods, acting uprightly, may the gift of the gods turn toward us!
We have approached the friendship of the gods; may the gods extend our lifespan that we may live!
May we hear what is auspicious with our ears, O gods; may we see what is auspicious with our eyes, O worshipful ones!
With firm limbs, praising with our bodies, may we attain the life appointed by the gods!
A hundred autumns indeed are before us, O gods, wherein you have placed old age for our bodies,
wherein sons become fathers; do not harm our life in the middle of its course!
We approach you, O gods—
And the fallen one, O gods, you gods lead up again;
and him who has committed sin, O gods, you gods make live again!
With the sacrifice the gods sacrificed to the sacrifice.

4.14.3.s: agne naya || pra vaḥ śukrāya bhānave bharadhvaṃ havyaṃ matiṃ cāgnaye supūtam | yo daivyāni mānuṣā janūṃṣy antar viśvāni vidmanā jigāti || agne tvaṃ pāraya || achā giro matayo devayantīr agniṃ yanti draviṇaṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ | susaṃdṛśaṃ supratīkaṃ svañcaṃ havyavāham aratiṃ mānuṣāṇām || agne tvam asmad yuyodhy amīvā anagnitrā abhyamanta kṛṣṭīḥ | punar asmabhyaṃ suvitāya deva kṣāṃ viśvebhir amṛtebhir yajatra || pra kāravo mananā vacyamānā devadrīcīṃ nayata devayantaḥ | dakṣiṇāvāḍ vājinī prācy eti havir bharanty agnaye ghṛtācī || ud uttamam astabhnād dyām imāṃ dhiyam || kitavāso yad riripur na dīvi yad vā ghā satyam uta yan na vidma | sarvā tā viṣya śithireva devāthā te syāma varuṇa priyāsaḥ || ava te heḍo varuṇa tat tvā yāmi || pāvīravī kanyā citrāyuḥ sarasvatī vīrapatnī dhiyaṃ dhāt | gnābhir achidraṃ śaraṇaṃ sajoṣā durādharṣaṃ gṛṇate śarma yaṃsat || ā no divaḥ || imā juhvānā yuṣmad ā namobhiḥ prati stomaṃ sarasvati juṣasva | tava śarman priyatame dadhānā upastheyāma śaraṇaṃ na vṛkṣam || yas te stanaḥ śaśayo yo mayobhūr yeṇa viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi | yo ratnadhā vasuvid yaḥ sudatraḥ sarasvati tam iha dhātave kaḥ || sarasvaty abhi no neṣi vasya idaṃ te havyam ||
4.14.3.d: अग्ने नय ॥ प्र वः शुक्राय भानवे भरध्वं हव्यं मतिं चाग्नये सुपूतम् । यो दैव्यानि मानुषा जनूंष्य् अन्तर् विश्वानि विद्मना जिगाति ॥ अग्ने त्वं पारय ॥ अछा गिरो मतयो देवयन्तीर् अग्निं यन्ति द्रविणं भिक्षमाणाः । सुसंदृशं सुप्रतीकं स्वञ्चं हव्यवाहम् अरतिं मानुषाणाम् ॥ अग्ने त्वम् अस्मद् युयोध्य् अमीवा अनग्नित्रा अभ्यमन्त कृष्टीः । पुनर् अस्मभ्यं सुविताय देव क्षां विश्वेभिर् अमृतेभिर् यजत्र ॥ प्र कारवो मनना वच्यमाना देवद्रीचीं नयत देवयन्तः । दक्षिणावाड् वाजिनी प्राच्य् एति हविर् भरन्त्य् अग्नये घृताची ॥ उद् उत्तमम् अस्तभ्नाद् द्याम् इमां धियम् ॥ कितवासो यद् रिरिपुर् न दीवि यद् वा घा सत्यम् उत यन् न विद्म । सर्वा ता विष्य शिथिरेव देवाथा ते स्याम वरुण प्रियासः ॥ अव ते हेडो वरुण तत् त्वा यामि ॥ पावीरवी कन्या चित्रायुः सरस्वती वीरपत्नी धियं धात् । ग्नाभिर् अछिद्रं शरणं सजोषा दुराधर्षं गृणते शर्म यंसत् ॥ आ नो दिवः ॥ इमा जुह्वाना युष्मद् आ नमोभिः प्रति स्तोमं सरस्वति जुषस्व । तव शर्मन् प्रियतमे दधाना उपस्थेयाम शरणं न वृक्षम् ॥ यस् ते स्तनः शशयो यो मयोभूर् येण विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि । यो रत्नधा वसुविद् यः सुदत्रः सरस्वति तम् इह धातवे कः ॥ सरस्वत्य् अभि नो नेषि वस्य इदं ते हव्यम् ॥
4.14.3.m:
O Agni, lead…
Bring forward for the bright light the offering, and a well-purified thought for Agni, / who with wisdom passes through all divine and human births.
O Agni, do you take across…
Toward Agni go the songs, the thoughts seeking the gods, begging for wealth, / [toward him] of fair sight, of fair face, moving well, the oblation-bearer, the master of men.
O Agni, ward off sickness from us; godless peoples have assailed [us]. / Again, for well-being to us, O god, [make] the earth [safe], along with all the immortals, O adorable one!
Brought forward with meditation, O poets, lead [the prayer] turned toward the gods, seeking the gods! / Winning the dakṣiṇā, rich in prizes, moving forward, the ladle dripping with ghee goes forward, bearing the oblation to Agni.
Up the highest…
He propped up the sky…
This thought…
What the gamblers have cheated, as at play, or what is true, or what we do not know— / loosen all those, O god, as if loose, and then may we be dear to you, O Varuṇa!
Off [turn] your wrath, O Varuṇa…
For that I ask you…
May the daughter of the thunderbolt, Sarasvatī, rich in life, having heroes for husbands, set insight [in us]! / In unison with the divine wives, may she grant unassailable protection, a shelter without gap, to the singer.
To us from the sky…
Being invoked here by us with homages, O Sarasvatī, take pleasure in our praise-song! / Placed in your dearest protection, may we approach [you] as a tree for shelter.
That breast of yours which is unfailing, which is refreshing, with which you nourish all desirable things, / which bestows treasures, finds wealth, gives well—O Sarasvatī, prepare that here to suckle!
O Sarasvatī, lead us to better…
This is your oblation…
